data.probe: Confirmed: the early return followed a symlinked .venv to the shared venv. Fixed in 6060f8841: now checks (venv/'pyvenv.cfg').is_file() AND not venv.is_symlink(); a symlinked .venv is unlinked and rebuilt locally. Test test_a_symlinked_venv_is_not_treated_as_isolated asserts the symlink is replaced by a real local .venv.

data.probe: Refuted (evidence, not speculation): the finding requires VIRTUAL_ENV=/repo/.venv or /repo/.venv/bin on PATH. In this orchestration neither holds: echo $VIRTUAL_ENV is empty, and [REDACTED:path] = [REDACTED:path] (nix python3.14) -- [REDACTED:path] is NOT on PATH. The ACTUAL bug B4e7af0f14f vector is uv pip/uv run virtualenv DISCOVERY (no VIRTUAL_ENV, no local .venv -> walks up to the shared .venv), which this fix closes: /tmp repro shows a .venv-less nested worktree's  repoints the shared .pth, and a worktree-local .venv stops that walk (parent .pth untouched). An agent explicitly exporting VIRTUAL_ENV at the primary venv is outside ddflow's claim-time control.
